properties.name: BL-125: canonicalise the checksum on BOTH sides of the drift comparison, not only on the way in. The 2026-07-25 write-side fix left drift.rs comparing literally, so the identical false red came back through the read door and a bare hash registered and observed reported drift on every artifact of an untouched tree. Measured at the real MCP surface before and after: unchanged 0 with a checksum_change and propagation_seeds seeded from a file nobody touched, then unchanged 1 with no findings and no seeds.
